target-inputs.request: Review the supplied items and synthesize the evidence.

objective: Determine whether the target workflow is contract-correct, safe to execute under its declared permissions, bounded, testable, and reusable.
review-lenses: Workflow schema, input types, strict output schemas, template references, and qualified target resolution
DAG dependencies, readiness, fan-out bounds, call budgets, timeouts, retries, and failure propagation
Sandbox, write authorization, path containment, untrusted-data handling, prompt injection, and destructive operations
Pinned agents, model and reasoning settings, snapshot drift, digest coverage, installation conflicts, and portability
Persistent-loop idempotency, checkpoints, recovery, pause, resume, cancellation, backoff, and write isolation when applicable
Documentation, example inputs, operator usability, test coverage, compatibility, clean installation, and false-green risks
acceptance-criteria: The target resolves and validates; the supplied inputs produce a bounded plan; schemas and dependencies fail closed; permissions are explicit and least-privilege; agent pins and loop invariants are consistent when used; documentation and tests cover core success and failure paths.
